viviendas.metaDesc: Full and partial renovations of flats and houses in Barcelona and surroundings. A clear quote before work starts and a single team for the whole job.
viviendas.heroSub: Full and partial renovations of flats and houses. A single team from the first visit to handover, with a clear quote before work starts.
viviendas.i1: Kitchens: cabinetry, worktop, appliances and installation
viviendas.i2: Bathrooms: plumbing, tiling, sanitaryware and shower screens
viviendas.i3: Layout: partitions, demolition and new rooms
viviendas.q1: How much does it cost to renovate a home in Barcelona?
viviendas.a1: As a reference, a cosmetic renovation starts from €180/m² and a full renovation from €590/m², depending on area, condition and materials. You'll find more reference prices under “Our prices”.
viviendas.q2: How long does a full renovation take?
viviendas.a2: An average flat (70–90 m²) usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, depending on scope and permits. We give you a written schedule with the quote.
viviendas.q3: Do I need a works permit?
viviendas.a3: Renovations that don't touch structure or façade usually require a minor-works notice. We help you with the necessary paperwork.
viviendas.q4: Can I live in the home during the works?
viviendas.a4: For partial renovations sometimes yes; for full ones it's best not to. We assess it at the visit.
viviendas.a5: Yes. All our work is guaranteed, and materials carry their manufacturer's warranty.

oficinas.metaDesc: Office renovations in Barcelona and surroundings: layout, systems, lighting and finishes. Functional workspaces, ready on schedule.
oficinas.heroSub: Functional, up-to-date workspaces, ready to operate. We coordinate the works to minimise the impact on your activity.
oficinas.i4: Raised floors, flooring and suspended ceilings
oficinas.q1: How much does it cost to renovate an office?
oficinas.a1: As a reference, a full commercial-unit renovation starts from €490/m², depending on systems and finishes. You'll find indicative line items under “Our prices”.
oficinas.q2: Can you work at night or on weekends?
oficinas.a2: Yes. We adapt the works schedule to reduce the impact on your activity and your neighbours'.
oficinas.q3: Do you handle the activity licence?
oficinas.a3: It can be assessed when the project requires it; we coordinate the necessary technical documentation.
oficinas.a4: Yes. From design to handover, with a single site manager and progress reports.
oficinas.a5: Yes, all work is guaranteed and materials carry their manufacturer's warranty.

tiendas.i1: The look of your premises: façade, shopfront and signage
tiendas.i2: Layout of the sales floor and stockroom

tiendas.q1: How much does it cost to renovate a commercial unit?
tiendas.a1: A full commercial-unit renovation starts from €490/m² as a reference, depending on condition, systems and finishes. See more line items under “Our prices”.
tiendas.q2: How long does a shop refit take?
tiendas.a2: A small or medium unit usually takes 4 to 10 weeks depending on scope. We set the schedule in the quote.
tiendas.q3: Can you work while the shop stays open?
tiendas.a3: When feasible, we organise the works in phases or outside opening hours so you don't have to stop trading.
tiendas.a4: It can be assessed when the project requires it; it isn't included in the indicative prices.

beauty.i1: Layout of treatment rooms, studios and changing rooms
beauty.q1: How much does it cost to renovate a salon or a gym?
beauty.a1: As a reference, a full commercial-unit renovation starts from €490/m², depending on systems and floor area. You'll find indicative line items under “Our prices”.
beauty.q2: How long does this type of work take?
beauty.a2: A small salon usually takes 4 to 8 weeks; a medium-sized gym, somewhat longer. We give you a written schedule.
beauty.q3: Do you meet health and accessibility requirements?
beauty.a3: Yes, we bring the premises in line with the applicable accessibility, ventilation and hygiene regulations for your activity.
beauty.a4: It can be assessed when the project requires it; it isn't included in the indicative prices.

banos.metaDesc: Bathroom renovation in Barcelona and surroundings: full bathroom from €4,900 and bath-to-shower swap from €1,290. Free visit and a written, itemised quote.
banos.h1: Bathroom renovation in Barcelona: complete, with a written quote
banos.heroSub: A single team handles the whole bathroom, from demolition to painting. Full bathroom from €4,900 and bath-to-shower conversion from €1,290, VAT not included; the exact amount, after a free visit.
banos.i1: Demolition and rubble removal: old sanitaryware, bath and tiling
banos.i2: Plumbing: new or relocated water supplies and drains
banos.i3: Electrics: general lighting, mirror light and sockets
banos.i4: Wall and floor tiling: ceramic or SPC vinyl flooring
banos.i5: Shower tray, screen and sanitaryware: toilet, basin and taps
banos.i6: Painting and finishes: skim coat, trims and final snagging
banos.q1: How much does it cost to renovate a bathroom in Barcelona?
banos.a1: A full bathroom starts from €4,900 at basic level, €7,000 at standard and €11,000 at premium; a bath-to-shower conversion, from €1,290. These are indicative prices, VAT not included; the final quote is agreed in writing after a free visit.
banos.q2: How much does it cost to swap the bath for a shower tray?
banos.a2: The published line item starts from €1,290, indicative and VAT not included. The exact scope and the price are confirmed at the free visit and set out in writing, with line items, materials and timeline, before work starts.
banos.q3: Do I need a works permit to renovate a bathroom?
banos.a3: A bathroom renovation that doesn't touch structure or façade usually requires a minor-works notice. We help you with the paperwork; handling permits isn't included in the indicative prices.
banos.q4: Can the quote change once the work has started?
banos.a4: We work with a quote agreed in writing before we start: you have the line items, materials and timeline detailed up front, so there are no surprises mid-job. All our work is also guaranteed, and materials carry their manufacturer's warranty.
banos.q5: Which areas do you cover for bathroom renovations?
banos.a5: Barcelona city and its surroundings, up to around 50 km depending on the project: L'Hospitalet, Badalona, Sant Cugat del Vallès (where our office is), Sabadell, Terrassa, Mataró, Granollers, Castelldefels or Sitges, among others. Get in touch and we'll confirm availability.

cookies.metaDesc: Information about the cookies Kobor uses: necessary, analytics and marketing cookies, and how to manage your consent.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.introText: A cookie is a small file that a website stores on your device when you visit. Cookies make the site work, remember your preferences and measure how the site is used. We also use equivalent technologies such as the browser's local storage.
cookies.whoText: The data controller is Kobor ([PENDING: legal name and tax ID]). Some cookies are managed by third parties: Google, through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Google Ads, and Microsoft, through Microsoft Clarity.
cookies.typesIntro: We group cookies into three categories. Except for the necessary ones, none are activated without your consent.
cookies.necessaryText: Essential for the site to work and to remember your cookie decision. They require no consent and can't be turned off.
cookies.analyticsText: Let us measure in aggregate how the site is used (page views, traffic source) to improve it, via Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity (heatmaps and anonymised session recordings). They are only activated if you accept them.
cookies.marketingText: Used to measure the effectiveness of our campaigns and show relevant advertising via Google Ads. They are only activated if you accept them.
cookies.consentText: We use Google Consent Mode v2: until you accept, all non-essential cookies stay blocked. You can accept, reject or choose by category in the notice shown when you arrive.
cookies.manageText: You can change your choice at any time, as easily as you gave it. Your decision is remembered for up to 180 days; after that we'll ask you again.
cookies.browserText: You can also block or delete cookies from your browser settings. Note that disabling some may affect how the site works.
cookies.moreText: To learn how we process your personal data, see our privacy policy. If you have questions, write to us at

privacy.metaDesc: How Kobor processes your personal data: controller, purposes, legal basis, retention, recipients and your rights (GDPR).
privacy.title: Privacy policy

p: The controller of your data is Kobor ([PENDING: legal name], tax ID [PENDING], registered at [PENDING: address]). You can reach us at admin@kobor.es.

We process the data you provide in the contact and quote forms (name, phone, email, your message and, if you attach them, the photos or plans of your renovation). If you accept cookies, we also process browsing and advertising-campaign data.
We use your data to respond to your request, prepare quotes and provide our renovation services. With your consent, we also measure the site's audience and show relevant advertising.
We process your data on the basis of your consent and of pre-contractual measures taken at your request. Analytics and advertising rely solely on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
We keep your data for as long as the relationship lasts and, afterwards, for the periods required by law. Data processed for marketing purposes is kept until you withdraw your consent.

We do not sell your data. We only share it with the providers that serve us (email and hosting) and, if you have given your consent, with Google for analytics and advertising and with Microsoft (Microsoft Clarity) for analytics.

Some providers, such as Google or Microsoft, may process data outside the European Economic Area. In that case the appropriate safeguards under the GDPR apply, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to admin@kobor.es. If you believe we have not handled your request properly, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
We use first- and third-party cookies as described in our cookie policy, where you can also manage your preferences.
We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration.
We may update this policy to reflect regulatory changes or changes to our services. The current version will always be published here.
